original_Arena.delivered_format: A genuine self-contained SB3 policy ZIP with embedded legal definition. It loads with PPO.load and the shared runtime, but is NOT directly accepted as the R2 outer submission container.
original_Arena.remaining: Confirm the actual competition loading contract, action-definition source and permitted no-integrity-check route. Available R2 is a practice guide and does not implement the announced qualification score. No claim that a newly published final release has been validated.
